name: avm-sp
description: AVM de apartamentos residenciais de São Paulo — site estático, inferência no navegador

scripts.lint: for f in site/assets/*.js src/*.js build.mjs scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs tests/fixtures/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && python3 -m py_compile train_model.py scripts/*.py tests/*.py && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run >/dev/null && echo lint ok
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run validate && python3 -m unittest tests.test_validate_model && npm test
